goal: Full dataset for AI for songs in Spotify or any platform — must have full dataset for AI, search GitHub if needed

github_existing.description: Extract public Spotify data — tracks, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts & lyrics — without official API, no key, sync+async, typed models, one dependency (httpx), bootstraps anonymous token from Spotify's public embed pages
github_existing.free: No API key, no OAuth, no quota, public data

github_existing.description: Scrape features about spotify tracks and website for recommendations from 7M+ tracks using custom k-nearest-neighbours
phases: Scrapes all followers of last scraped followers of given user (unofficial reverse-engineered API)
Scrapes all playlists of all users
Scrapes IDs of all tracks of all playlists
Scrapes audio features of all tracks (official API)

phase1.name: Spotify Public Data without API Key
phase1.method: Use SpotifyScraper approach: bootstrap anonymous token from public embed pages https://open.spotify.com/embed/*, read JSON endpoints web player uses, typed models

phase2.name: Playlists & Followers Expansion
phase2.method: Unofficial reverse-engineered API: scrape followers of followers, then playlists of users, then track IDs of playlists (msr8 approach)

phase3.name: Audio Features
phase3.method: Official Spotify API for audio features: danceability, energy, liveness, valence, tempo, etc — requires API key but free tier, or use public data

free_storage.note: All free, SpotifyScraper no key, no quota

engineering.proxy_rotation: Rotate proxy/location every time, anti-ban built in, per-host rate limiting, retries with backoff, UA rotation
engineering.free_api: SpotifyScraper public embed token, no API key, no OAuth
engineering.ai: NVIDIA for categorization, recommendations via k-nearest-neighbours like msr8
